headline: BIG NEWS FOR WORKERS: Government Proposes 600 Euro Minimum Wage, Vučić Reveals How the State Will Help
summary: Serbia's government has proposed a minimum wage of 600 euros for next year. President Aleksandar Vučić said the state will have to help employers with the increase.
why: Minimum wage decisions shape labour costs, consumer spending and inflation pressure, which matter for employers and investors in Serbia.
